title.en: A picture is a table of numbers

t.zh: 传感器的每个像素记下一个亮度，一张灰度图就是一张 h 行、w 列的数表；彩色图的每格是红、绿、蓝三个数。约定：x 向右数、y 向下数，都从 0 开始，第 y 行第 x 列写作 (x, y)。
t.en: Each sensor pixel records a brightness, so a grey picture is a table of h rows and w columns; in a colour one each cell holds three numbers, red, green and blue. The convention: x counts right and y down, both from 0, and row y, column x is written (x, y).

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一个像素在数表的哪里，怎样读出它的值？先在格子上指出坐标、改一个彩色像素，再接一块读相邻两个像素之差的电路。
t.en: This level asks: where in the table is a pixel, and how is its value read? First give a cell's coordinates and change a colour pixel on the grid, then wire a circuit that reads the difference between two neighbouring pixels.

after.en: This is how an <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> is laid out: its shape is h × w (× 3 in colour), read at (x, y) by the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 写出高亮那一格的坐标 (x, y)。
brief.en: Write the coordinates (x, y) of the highlighted cell.

hint.zh: x 是第几列，y 是第几行，都从 0 数起。
hint.en: x is the column and y the row, both counted from 0.

why.zh: 这是先写行、再写列（矩阵的习惯）：图像坐标先写 x（列），再写 y（行），高亮的格子在第 1 行第 2 列，是 (2, 1)。
why.en: That gives the row first, the matrix way: image coordinates give x, the column, first and y, the row, second; the highlighted cell is in row 1, column 2, so (2, 1).

brief.zh: 把 (1, 0) 的像素改成纯红，其他格子不动。
brief.en: Change the pixel at (1, 0) to pure red, leaving every other cell as it is.

hint.zh: 一个彩色像素是三个数，按红、绿、蓝的顺序。
hint.en: A colour pixel is three numbers, in the order red, green, blue.

why.zh: 改的是 (0, 1)：x 和 y 写反了。(1, 0) 是第 0 行第 1 列。
why.en: That changes (0, 1): x and y swapped. (1, 0) is row 0, column 1.

t.zh: 新元件：<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>按坐标读出一个像素，<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数，<part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref>相减。
t.en: New parts: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads the pixel at coordinates, <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> gives a fixed number, <part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref> subtracts.

brief.zh: 输入一张灰度图和坐标 x、y：交出右边邻居 (x+1, y) 减去 (x, y) 的值。
brief.en: Given a grey image and coordinates x and y, give the value at (x+1, y) less the value at (x, y).

hint.zh: 取像素的两个坐标口，哪个是列、哪个是行？
hint.en: Of the lookup's two coordinate inputs, which is the column and which the row?
